phase: Headless runtime / peer-local persistence Phase A

deliverables.summary: Conceptual peer-local persistence facets: node log, blob CAS, optional index; lifecycle hooks open/hydrate/append_nodes/flush/checkpoint/recover.
Bounded reason_class set for adapter failures (unavailable, version_skew, corruption, tail_conflict, quota, readonly) with recovery posture guidance.
Additive capabilities; NodalMerge-first config; no silent cross-backend migration in v1.

completion_gate.notes: Lifecycle semantics (hydrate, flush, checkpoint, recovery) are specified in-plan; formal multi-stream review to close gate.
